fields.name: ArgentSeaGrainPersistenceException construction
fields.contract: Consumers can construct ArgentSeaGrainPersistenceException with no diagnostic text, with diagnostic text, or with diagnostic text and a causal Exception. For the latter two variants, the resulting exception preserves the supplied diagnostic text; the causal variant also preserves the supplied Exception as InnerException.
